basic_info.description: Quiet two-level condo featuring 2 spacious bedrooms and 1 modern bathroom. Triple pane windows! Embrace sustainable living while maintaining a luxurious atmosphere in the city's first LEED certified green high-rise, designed for eco-conscious residents. Enjoy an open-concept living and dining area bathed in natural light, complimented by a gourmet kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances. Step out onto your private balcony for a breath of fresh air and city views. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, ample storage, and access to community amenities like a rooftop deck, BBQ area and community room steps from the unit door. The proximity of these amenities offers excellent additional square footage to your living space, especially for hosting guests. There's a fitness center and rental guest rooms located on the 2nd floor. This location is like no other, nestled across the street from the house boats in the channel, well-maintained walking paths, steps from Oracle Park, Chase Center, restaurants and CalTrain. Additional perks: 24-hour front desk attendant, 24-hour street patrol around the channel; free shuttle to downtown and back; outdoor basketball, sand volleyball, tennis courts, kayak rental and dog park on this block of Berr
